translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: MAGA
book.title: Maga Magahanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Wali agali dewaore daosini mariame (4,000) tomo no karula penego ogo
Horo uruningi wali agali dewa lone ngoai howa ti tomo nolene nawiyagola Yasuhanda ibunaga talima piaga biaruhondo, Ibidaba, lowa tihondo lalu,
Wali agali dewa i̱ heba horo tebiru haabo harimagome áyu tomo nolene nawidago dara ho ko.
I̱na, Tí andaga pudaba, laruyagua maru dindi kaundia howa ibini karu ti garibi timbuni lowa hariga obeneni pialu karia de mborere bialu odope habehe ka, lene.
Ibunaga talima piaga biarume ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Ina dindi ko yobi wali agali nahaga tomo nawini kamago wali agali bu karuni tomo no karulape nelo iname tomo agiha taibu muleberamabe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda tihondo lalu, Mberedi agira henedamibe, lene. Tigua ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Mberedi karia henedama, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda wali agali bu hearuni, Dindini birai hadaba, lowa ibugua mberedi karia biaru mo yuwa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo turu halu ka̱i̱ lowa gaibu baga buwa talima piaga biaruhondo mini. Ani miyagola tigua wali agali biru wiaruhondo ta halu mini.
Tigua wena emene mbira mbira heneneyagobi Yasuhanda ka̱i̱ lowa, Wali agali nelo midaba, lene.
Wali agali bibahendeme karulape nalu no ibira hayago mialu ibunaga talima piaga biarume nu karia hono to̱lai hene. Ogoningi wali agali tomo nalu hayadaru dewaore daosini maria (4,000) agima hene.
Yasuhanda wali agalihondo, Andaga pudaba, lowa ibu ibunaga talima piaga biaru heba iba taluni biralu Dalamanuda dindi pene.
Agalime nabiagane ale bia, lenego ogo

Perisi agali maru hearu Yasu hearia ibuwa lai lalu hene. Tigua Yasuhanda mbira agi larabe hondole ibuhondo lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabehanda í̠ha howa heneneore birabe hondoloma̱ya í̠na agalime nabiagane ale mbira bia handa, lene.

Yasuhanda ibunaga bu habaneha mini burugu lowa hi̱ he̱ lowa lalu, Wali agali áyu karume agalime nabiagane ale dege hondole hai bialu kago irane aginagabe. Tíhondo henene laro wali agali áyu karume agalime nabiagane ale de hendelo walia naholebira, lene.
Ani lowa ibugua Perisi agali biaru helalu iba taluni lone biralu iba timbuniore bereago domalu dindi edeyagi pene.
Perisinagabi Herodonagabi mo hiwa hagane mini yidi te laminigo ogo
Yasunaga talima piaga biarume mberedi maru embeda halu mbira hangu hanalu iba taluni pene.
Ibugua tihondo hongo howa lalu, Perisi agalinagabi Herodonagabi mo hiwa hagane mini yidi ngago de hondowa bayuwa mamage ho halimu, lene.
Ani layagola hale howa tini hangume laga laga bialu lalu, Ibugua o laragoni iname mberedi nahene ibirimago lara, lalu hene.
Tigua ani layagola manda buwa Yasuhanda tihondo lalu, Tígua mberedi nahene ibirimada lowa lalu kami agibe. Tí manda nabi haabo howa tínaga bu mini giambe hayabe.

Tínaga de bayale howa de nahende halu tínaga hale bayale howa hale nahe kamibe. Mberedi homane duria wali agali daosini duriame (5,000) no karula pelo gaibu baga birugo mitangi nabi kamibe. Ti nalu ibira hayagola mberedi no ibira hayago nu agira hono to̱lo hanarimiyabe, lene. Ani layagola tigua ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Nu homberia (12) hanarima, lene.

Tigua ani layagola ibugua lalu, Wali agali daosini mariame (4,000) nelo mberedi karia gaibu baga birugo no ibira hayago nu agira hono to̱lo hanarimiyabe, lene. Tigua ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Nu karia hanarima, lene.
Ibugua tihondo lalu, Tí manda nabi haabo kamigo agibe, lene.
Agali mbira de kohe mo dabi henego ogo
Ti dindi ogoni yu wahalu Bedesaida anda pene. Anda piyagola agali marume agali mbira de kohe heago Yasu hearia haru ibuwa ibuhondo lalu, Agali ogoni í̠ gime ela habelo haru íbu kama, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda agali de kohe biago gime yalu anda bu heagoria howa tagira haru pene. Ibugua agali de kohe heagonaga deni hamiaga tolo ba howa ibu gime ela halu agali biagohondo lalu, Mbirale mbira hendedebe, lene.
Ani layagola agali biagome dengalowa lalu, Agali ira ale ibaga bialu kago de hendedo, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda agali biagonaga deni lone ela hayagola ibunaga de bayale halu mbirale bibahende de handai hene.
Ani biyagola Yasuhanda agali biagohondo lalu, Anda dewa bu kagoria dai nabi í̠ni andaga puabo habe, lene.
Pidahanda, Mbirali Dabo Helenego ibulebira lowinigo í̠ore kegoni, lenego ogo

Yasu ibunaga talima piaga biaru heba dindi ti hayagoni yu wahalu Sisaria Pilibaihayagi ibaga bialu pene. Pialu howa ibugua ibunaga talima piaga biaruhondo lalu, Wali agali karume i̱ ai ka lalu kabe, lene.

Ani layagola tigua ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Wali agali marume, Baboraya biaga Yone ka, lalu marume, Elaya ka, lalu marume, Ngode Datagaliwabe bi mana latagi haga agali mbira ka, larago, lalu lamini.
Ani lamiyagola ibugua tihondo lalu, Tígua i̱ ai ka lalu kamibe, lene. Pidahanda ibuhondo ladai bialu lalu, Mbirali Dabo Helenego ibulebira lowinigo í̠ore kegoni, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda tihondo hongo howa lalu, I̱ni kogonigo wali agali karu nalamilimu, lene.
Yasuhanda ibuni tandaga nalu homolenenaga te lenego ogo

Yasuhanda ibunaga talima piaga biaru lawai halu lalu, Agali Hole Ibiyago ibu tandaga timbuni nolebira. Agali ala hene miniwi karubi loma binigo mo miaga haguane karubi Mana lowinigo lawai haga karubi tigua ibu hame nalolebira. Tigua ibu homelo baragola homalu horo kiru howa tebonengi ibuni mo heya holebira, lene.
Ibugua bi ogoni tigatiga lamiyagola Pidahanda Yasu haru pu bagi howa talialu lalu, Ani nalabe, lene.

Ani layagola Yasu ibu beregedalu ibunaga talima piaga biaru handaya howa ibugua Pida talialu lalu, Dama Heyolabe i̱ kogoria nahe pu. Ngode Datagaliwabehanda manda bidadagua ndo agalime manda biagadagua manda bide, lene.

Ani lowa ibugua wali agali hearubi ibunaga talima piaga biarubi, Tí bibahende ibidaba, lowa tihondo lalu, Mbiralime i̱ porodagua ibua ho kayagua nde ibuni hame ledago mitangi nabi ibuninaga ira banga yalu i̱ talima ibulene nga.
Mbiralime ibuninaga holene ngago mo tene hayagua nde holene ogoni ereba hai holebira. Mbiralime i̱bi i̱naga bi mana debenebi mo tene howa ibuni holene wahayagua ogoni ibu holene bayale yu holebira.
Mbiralime dindi bibahendeni ngaru mo teneho kaore ibuninaga holene maro biyagua ibu biamogo bulebirabe. Biamogo nabulebiraore.
Ibuninaga holenego lone mo yu dai bule ibugua mbira bibe naheore.

Wali agali Ngode Datagaliwabe mana hale nahaga karubi ko biaga karubi hondowa mbiralime i̱ minibi i̱naga bi manabi lamulene taga hayagua Agali Hole Ibiyago ibu Abanaga wá holene taraorebi Ngode Datagaliwabenaga dahuliyali loma bia henerubi heba dai birangi ibugua nde o biago hondowa taga holebira, Yasuhanda lene.
